summary.text: Will Greer is a Democratic state representative from Vermont who has represented the Bennington-2 District since January 2025 and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is secretary of the Vermont Democratic Party.

paragraphs.text: Will Greer was born in Nacogdoches, Texas.
According to Ballotpedia, his career experience includes working as secretary of the Vermont Democratic Party.
He was first seated in the Vermont House of Representatives on January 8, 2025, and advanced from the Democratic primary on August 11, 2026.
